patch_description: This crossover keeps the stronger current program’s 12 move-plus-alter post-actions, avoiding reverse-direction target blocking that slightly reduced the inspiration program’s measured score. It rewrites the internal pathfinding and state representation for lower overhead: compact byte grids, integer-index BFS queues, reusable predecessor arrays, and reduced allocation. The greedy construction and simulated annealing structure are retained, while greedy local reoptimization tests all strategy codes for a selected segment instead of a random subset.
